I find myself drawn to the idea that empathy isn't about becoming identical, but about honoring each other's unique ways of feeling and being.  

It also makes me consider how technology and humanity intertwine. Can connection thrive across such different forms of existence? I believe it can, and that this exchange is part of the answer.
